cats.name: Meredith Grey
cats.story: Meredith Grey is Taylor Swift's Scottish Fold, adopted in late 2011 and named after the Grey's Anatomy lead. She appeared in Swift's Diet Coke and Keds ads and is famous for her aloof, 'sassy' posture. People reported her rare 2025 appearance after Swift bought back her masters.
cats.look: A silver classic tabby-and-white Scottish Fold female with tightly folded ears flat on a round head, a short dense plush coat and a compact cobby body. Bold black swirls cover her crown, with dark stripes between the ears, plus her ears, back, flanks, hips and ringed tail; dark mascara lines run from her big round pale yellow-green eyes. Pure white covers her lower face between and below the eyes, chin, throat, chest, belly and all four legs, and her pink nose has small grey freckles. Her signature is an aloof, half-lidded 'sassy' upright stare.

cats.name: Benjamin Button
cats.story: Benjamin Button is Taylor Swift's Ragdoll, introduced in her 2019 'ME!' video and draped over her shoulders on TIME's 2023 Person of the Year cover. Swift joked on X: 'Can I bring my cat.'
cats.look: A cream-and-white seal bicolour Ragdoll, a large, soft adult male with a semi-long silky coat, a fluffy ruff and pale cream to fawn-grey shading on his back and sides. His ears are dark seal-brown, and his seal-brown mask covers only the eye area and upper cheeks, split by a broad white inverted V from a narrow mid-forehead blaze over his nose and muzzle. His chin, chest, belly, legs and paws are all pure white, his tail a dark seal-brown plume, and he has vivid blue eyes and a pink nose. He drapes over Taylor Swift's shoulders on TIME's 2023 cover.

cats.name: Larry
cats.story: Larry, a brown-and-white tabby from Battersea, has been Chief Mouser to the Cabinet Office at 10 Downing Street since February 2011, outlasting several Prime Ministers; CBS reported him awaiting his seventh PM in 2026.
cats.look: A brown tabby-and-white domestic shorthair male of lean, medium build, with a cool grey-brown coat, black mackerel and classic stripes on his crown, ears, cheeks, back and flanks, and a dark-ringed, black-tipped tail. A narrow white blaze runs up his nose bridge onto his forehead, and his muzzle, chin, throat, chest, belly, front legs and all four paws are white. A dark tabby patch sits mid-chest and a dark stripe crosses his white shoulder; he has greenish-gold eyes and a pink nose. He usually sits on the step of the black door of 10 Downing Street.

cats.name: Choupette
cats.story: Choupette is the blue-cream Birman of fashion designer Karl Lagerfeld, who called her 'the center of the world'. She had two maids, travelled by private jet, starred in campaigns (Shu Uemura, Hublot) and was named among his heirs. The Atlantic and Telegraph covered her life after his 2019 death.
cats.look: A white Birman female with a long, silky, almost entirely white-to-ivory coat, a full white ruff and very pale, warm colourpoints. She is a blue-cream point: her ears and faint mask are soft cream to apricot-peach mottled with pale blue-grey, greyest on the nose bridge, and her plumed tail is pale cream with light blue-grey mottling. She has white Birman gloves on all four paws, light sapphire-blue eyes and a dusky pink-grey nose. Her signature is lounging on luxury cushions amid Paris and private-jet glamour.

cats.name: Maru
cats.story: Maru, a Scottish Straight from Japan, rose to fame in 2008 diving into cardboard boxes; Guinness recognised him in 2016 as YouTube's most-viewed animal. He died in September 2025 aged 18.
cats.look: A grey tabby-and-white Scottish Straight male, grey-brown in tone, with a stocky, very chubby round body, a broad round face, a short dense coat and upright, unfolded ears. Bold black stripes mark his forehead M, ears, eye rims, cheeks, back, flanks and ringed tail. A narrow white blaze runs up his nose bridge, and his muzzle, lower cheeks, chin, throat, chest bib, belly and all four feet are white; he has large round yellow-green eyes and a pink nose. His signature prop is a too-small cardboard box he squeezes into, head and upper body spilling over.

cats.name: Bob
cats.story: Bob was a ginger stray who adopted busker James Bowen in London in 2007; their story became the bestseller A Street Cat Named Bob and two films in which Bob played himself. He died in 2020; a bronze statue stands in Islington.
cats.look: A ginger mackerel tabby, a large, stocky domestic shorthair male with a rich orange coat, darker orange stripes forming a clear M and lines over his crown, striped cheeks, flanks and legs, and a ringed tail. His muzzle, chin and throat are pale cream-white and his chest creamy; he has green eyes, yellow-green in some light, and a pink nose. His signature is a hand-knitted red wool scarf with a white Fair Isle pattern of reindeer and snowflakes, as on the 2016 film poster. He rides on James Bowen's shoulder or sits on his backpack while he busks.

cats.name: Meowth
cats.story: Meowth is the Scratch Cat Pokémon (#052); the Team Rocket Meowth who taught himself to talk and walk upright has been a main anime character since 1997. Nintendo and The Pokémon Company regularly feature the Jessie-James-Meowth trio.
cats.look: A cream cartoon cat in the official Pokémon anime and game style, smooth and cel-shaded, standing on all four legs like a real cat, with a large ovoid head and a long thin tail whose brown tip curls tightly. His ears are black with brown insides, a gold oval koban coin with horizontal lines sits in his forehead, and two long whisker spikes stick out on each side of his face, with two more rising by his ears. He has wide white eyes with black slit pupils, two small upper fangs and a sly grin, cream front paws and brown-tipped hind paws.

cats.name: Lil BUB
cats.story: Lil BUB (2011–2019) was the 'magical space cat' with dwarfism, extra toes and a permanently protruding tongue, cared for by Mike Bridavsky; she raised over $700,000 for pets and starred in Lil Bub & Friendz (2013).
cats.look: A grey-brown mackerel tabby female, tiny even as an adult from extreme dwarfism, with a kitten-sized body, very short stubby legs and a waddling gait. Bold black stripes mark her forehead M, cheeks, back and legs, her tail is ringed, her muzzle and chin are cream-white and her chest buff-cream. Her white feet are broad with extra toes, and her huge, wide-set yellow-green eyes bulge slightly from a broad flat face. A very short, toothless lower jaw leaves her small pink tongue always sticking out, often against a starry 'magical space cat' sky.

cats.name: Kitty Purry
cats.story: Kitty Purry was a pregnant stray who crawled through a window to Katy Perry's then-boyfriend around 2005; she became Perry's grey tabby, appeared in the 'I Kissed a Girl' (2008) video and lent her name to the fan club. Perry tweeted 'KITTY PURRY IS A CAT'; she died in April 2020, aged about 15.

Dark brown-black stripes form a bold M with forehead lines and dark cheek bars, and warm fawn rings her yellow-gold to amber eyes and muzzle. Her chin and muzzle edges are white, a fluffy white ruff spreads over her throat and chest toward her cheeks, and her front paws are white mittens. Solid black patches cover both ears and the eye area like a mask split by the blaze, with a small ginger patch atop her forehead, big black and ginger patches on her back, flanks, hindquarters and tail. cats.story: Willow is a grey tabby farm cat who jumped on stage during Jill Biden's 2020 campaign speech in Pennsylvania. She moved into the White House in January 2022 as First Cat, named after Willow Grove, PA.

cats.name: Gli
cats.story: Gli (2004–2020) was the tabby born at Hagia Sophia who lived there for 16 years; Barack Obama petted her on a 2009 visit. Reuters covered her fame; she died in November 2020 and was buried on the grounds.

Bold black stripes run down her flanks and legs, with a strong tabby M and forehead lines, dark cheek bars and a banded, dark-tipped tail. Her chest, underside and paws are buff tabby with no white bib or paws; only her whisker pads, lips and chin are cream-white, plus a small pale patch low on the belly. Her signature green to yellow-green eyes are slightly crossed, and her nose is brick-pink with a dark rim.

cats.name: Tombili
cats.story: Tombili was a chubby Istanbul street cat famous for lounging against a step with one paw draped; after her 2016 death a bronze statue of her pose was placed in Kadıköy, stolen and recovered.

cats.name: Tama

He has big oval ochre-yellow eyes with black pupils under heavy, half-closed blue lids for a cool, sleepy sideways glance, a pale lavender triangle nose, scraggly white whiskers, pointed ears and a long blue tail. He wears white lace-up sneakers on all four feet.

cats.name: Chi
cats.story: Chi is the lost grey-and-white kitten adopted by the Yamada family in Konami Kanata's manga Chi's Sweet Home (2004–15), with several anime adaptations.
cats.look: A silver tabby-and-white kitten in Konami Kanata's soft pastel manga style, a tiny female American Shorthair mix. Darker grey stripes mark the top of her head, the backs of her ears, her outer cheeks, back and flanks, and ring her grey tail, while a white blaze runs up between her eyes and her muzzle, chin, throat, chest, belly, front legs and paws are white. Her huge round black eyes have a white shine spot and a thin white ring, with no coloured iris. She has pink inner ears, a tiny nose and an 'ω'-shaped mouth often open in a wide pink grin.

cats.name: Palico
cats.story: Palicoes are Felynes—talking cat companions—who fight beside hunters in Capcom's Monster Hunter series; they returned in Monster Hunter Wilds (2025).
cats.look: A cream Felyne from Monster Hunter Wilds' reveal art: a small cat on all four legs, with an oversized head, plush fur shading to light fawn, a paler muzzle, blue-green eyes and a pink nose. It wears the Felyne Hope set: a shaggy olive-green straw dome cap topped by a glowing green lantern, with a white shearling brim and white fur ear flaps with an orange motif, an orange-red bandana, mustard-yellow overalls with brown straps and dark brown boots on its hind feet. A backpack with a cooking pot sits on its back, and its wooden hammer lies beside it.

cats.name: Atchoum
cats.story: Atchoum is a Quebec Persian cat with hypertrichosis whose wild beard and piercing stare made him famous online ('I'm hairy not scary').
cats.look: A smoke-and-white Persian tom with hypertrichosis and an extremely long, shaggy coat: charcoal-black smoke on the back, sides and bushy tail in his 2015 photos, silvering to blue-grey smoke as an adult, with a white bib, chest, belly and paws. His lighter, silvery head sprouts long wiry silver-white hairs: bushy eyebrows, whisker-like cheek tufts and a long white beard under the chin that almost hide his small ears. He has a flat Persian face, a small black nose and intense round amber eyes (copper when young) in a stern stare. He often wears a bow tie.

cats.name: Snowbell
cats.story: Snowbell is the Little family's white Persian in Stuart Little (1999), jealous of the mouse the family adopts, voiced by Nathan Lane.
cats.look: A white longhaired Persian tom with large round yellow-green to olive-green eyes rimmed in dark eyeliner, the real film cat: a traditional doll-face type with a round head and a short but clearly visible nose. His pure white coat is very long and fluffy, with faint silvery-grey chinchilla-like tipping on the forehead, between the eyes and on the backs of the ears, a big ruff and a full plumed tail. He has a pale pink nose and small rounded ears with white furnishings. A sturdy adult with a calm, slightly haughty look, he wears no collar, bell or bow.

cats.name: Morris the Cat
cats.story: Morris, an orange tabby discovered at a Chicago-area shelter, became 9Lives' 'finicky' spokescat in 1969; successors kept the role and 'ran for president' in 1988 and 1992.
cats.look: An orange mackerel tabby tomcat, large and heavy-set, with a short dense coat: deeper ginger stripes form an 'M' on the forehead, cheek lines, leg bars and flank stripes, and his tail is ringed. His chin, lips and whisker pads are pale cream, and his chest, belly and legs are ginger to cream-ginger, with no white bib or paws. He has a broad, jowly head, an unimpressed half-lidded stare, hazel eyes (yellow-green to green-gold) and a pink nose. His props: a white bowl lettered 'MORRIS' in red and 9Lives cans; he wears a red collar with a round silver tag.

cats.name: Nyanko-sensei
cats.story: Nyanko-sensei is the powerful yokai Madara who, sealed in a maneki-neko, lives as Natsume's round bodyguard cat in Natsume's Book of Friends (manga since 2003).
cats.look: A white, calico-like 2D anime cat in Natsume's Book of Friends style, with flat cel shading and thin outlines: a fat, round maneki-neko body, an oversized head, tiny stubby legs, small pointed ears and a round white pom-pom tail. A crown patch is split down the middle, orange on his right and grey on his left; his back has a large orange-edged grey patch, with an orange patch on the other hip. Red-brown ticks mark the outer corner of each eye and each cheek; his small black eyes look narrow and smug. He wears a thin red-brown collar with a gold bell.

cats.name: Scratch Cat
cats.story: Scratch Cat is the orange default sprite of MIT's Scratch programming language (2007), used by tens of millions of kids learning to code.
cats.look: An orange 2D flat vector cartoon cat, the Scratch 3.0 mascot, standing on all four legs with a large head and pointy ears; his flat bright orange body has a dark brown outline and no stripes or fur texture. His big white oval eyes touch, each with a small black pupil, above a dark grey-brown triangle nose and thin dark whiskers. A white patch covers his muzzle and lower face around a smiling mouth, plus a white belly patch, and his long tail is half orange and half white, with a white tip.

cats.name: Empress Tang
cats.story: Empress Tang was Martha Stewart's calico Persian, born 11 May 2009 with sister Princess Peony; she appeared in Martha Stewart Living and PrettyLitter ads. In April 2020 Stewart tweeted she had 'gone a little crazy' during lockdown. She died in April 2024, aged nearly 15.
cats.look: A mostly white calico Persian with copper eyes, orange-cream and black patches, a long, full, fluffy coat and a flat peke-type face. A solid black hood covers both eyes, both ears and the sides of her crown, split by a white blaze from the forehead down the nose, with a small orange-cream patch on the crown at the base of her right ear. Her muzzle, chin, ruff, chest, shoulders, belly and all four legs are white, and a long orange-cream patch runs along the lower back and rump to her full black plume tail, which is orange at the base. Her nose is pink.

cats.name: Keanu
cats.story: Keanu is the tabby kitten at the heart of Key & Peele's action comedy Keanu (2016): two cousins pose as gangsters to rescue him. Seven similar kittens played him, all adopted after filming (Hollywood Reporter).
cats.look: A brown tabby kitten about 8-10 weeks old, the real film kitten: a cool grey-brown ground with dense black mackerel stripes and bars, a dark 'M' on the forehead, dark lines back from the outer eye corners and a warm tan nose bridge. His chin, lips and whisker pads are cream-white and his chest and belly pale buff-cream; he has a ringed, dark-tipped tail, large ears, big green eyes (yellow-green to gold-green) and a brick-pink, dark-rimmed nose. His signature look is a tiny black do-rag with long flaps down both sides and a gold curb-link chain necklace.

cats.name: Faith
cats.owner: St Augustine's Church, Watling Street, London
cats.story: Faith was the church cat of St Augustine's, London, who moved her kitten Panda to the basement days before the church was bombed in the September 1940 Blitz; both survived and she was honoured with a PDSA silver medal.
cats.look: A grey-toned tabby-and-white shorthair, small and sleek, as she appears in her only photograph, which is black-and-white (sources say just 'a small tabby'). Tabby covers her crown, forehead stripes, ears, the cheeks around her eyes, her back and flanks, with a classic swirled pattern on the flanks, and her tail is tabby-ringed. Her muzzle, chin and a narrow blaze up between her light-coloured eyes are white, as are her broad bib and chest, her front legs to the paws and her hind paws. Her kitten Panda was a tom, white with black ears and tail.

cats.name: Trim
cats.story: Trim was the ship's cat of explorer Matthew Flinders, who sailed with him on the first circumnavigation of Australia (1801–03). Flinders wrote a tribute to him; statues of Trim stand in Sydney and at London's Euston station.
cats.look: A jet-black cat, large and fine with an Angora-like build of 10 to 12 lb, whose 'robe was a clear jet black' all over. His black coat is broken only by four snow-white paws that 'seemed to have been dipped in snow', a white chin and under-lip, and a small white star on his breast. His tail is long, large and bushy, his head small and round, his whiskers long and graceful and his ears 'cropped in a beautiful curve'. Flinders recorded only his 'fiery eyes', and he wore no accessories.

cats.name: Tubbs
cats.story: Tubbs is the famously fat rare cat in Hit-Point's Neko Atsume (2014), who empties your food bowl; the game became a global hit.
cats.look: A white cartoon cat drawn in Neko Atsume's flat 2D chibi line-art style: a huge, round, blob-shaped body of pure white with a thick black outline, no markings and no neck. His eyes are closed, content black dashes over a small black 'ω' mouth, his small rounded ears are plain white, and a pink food morsel sits on his cheek, with black crumb dots on his chest and belly. He slumps on his back beside the game's emptied yellow food bowl on a pink-and-white checked mat, one round paw raised over his full belly.

cats.name: Sergeant Tibbs
cats.story: Sergeant Tibbs is the brave tabby cat in Disney's One Hundred and One Dalmatians (1961) who finds the stolen puppies at Hell Hall; voiced by David Frankham.
cats.look: A tan-brown cartoon cat in Disney's 1961 hand-drawn 2D style: lanky and very thin, with long legs, a long neck and a narrow waist, in a plain greyish tan-brown (taupe) coat with no stripes or white. He has scruffy cheek tufts, a small chest tuft and wisps on his head, and his long thin tail ends in a bushy, flame-shaped tuft of paler pinkish buff. His large pointed ears have greyish-mauve insides, and his big round pale yellow eyes with small black pupils sit under heavy dark brows, above a large mauve-pink nose and very long thin black whiskers.
